description: Low-volatility stocks exhibit higher risk-adjusted momentum because they are less subject to speculative bubbles and crashes, so ranking by 63-day momentum divided by 63-day volatility should select more persistent trends; falsified if forward Sharpe is not higher than the best existing 63d-skip-0 momentum strategy (currently -2.53).
title: Low-Volatility Momentum · 63d skip 0 · Top 500 · Long Only
